sources.entry: Langflow | Visual builder for AI agents and workflows

summary.one_liner: Langflow is an open-source platform for building, running, and deploying AI agents and workflows, with a visual builder plus built-in API and MCP server deployment.
summary.what_it_does: Langflow provides a visual interface for assembling AI agent and workflow pipelines, and a Python source-code layer for customizing any component. Flows can be tested interactively in a playground with step-by-step control. Each workflow can be deployed as an API, exported as JSON for Python apps, or served as an MCP server so its flows act as tools for MCP clients. The README says it supports all major LLMs, vector databases, and a growing library of AI tools, and mentions multi-agent orchestration, conversation management, and retrieval. It also lists observability integrations with LangSmith and LangFuse.
use_cases: prototype LLM pipelines with a playground
how_to_run: make run_cli (from a cloned repository, for contributors)
notable: Visual builder combined with Python source access for customizing components
Any workflow can be deployed as an API or as an MCP server
Langflow Desktop installer for Windows and macOS with dependencies bundled
Observability integrations with LangSmith and LangFuse
caveats: Official release packages and Docker images require authentication by default; LANGFLOW_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD must be set before starting
Langflow Desktop is listed only for Windows and macOS
Existing auto-login installations need upgrade steps before switching defaults
